testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a part file before opening it: scenario/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a part file before opening it ✔ Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a folder contains a saved part with a preview and recorded metadata ✔ When the user presses Control+O and navigates to that folder ✔ And the user selects the saved part ✔ Then the part row is selected and the file name field identifies it ✔ And the preview displays the part ✔ And the Options pane displays Model State and Design View controls ✔ When the user chooses Details ✔ Then the preview remains visible ✔ And the details include the file type, modification date, size, author and part number ✔ When the user cancels the Open dialog ✔ Then the previously active part document remains displayed
